page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7t.8xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz. Utilizing the x86_64 architecture, it features 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 16 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a 2.0 GB per core ratio. It operates on a KVM hypervisor and does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

Benchmark results place the ecs.c7t.8xlarge consistently in the average performance tier across various compute and memory tests. The instance achieved a single-core stress-ng CPU score of 1860.49 and a multi-core score of 31104.89. In memory performance, it registered a read-only small block bandwidth of 1685.59 GB/sec and a large block write speed of 66.82 GB/sec. For specialized workloads, the instance demonstrated a strong result in LLM text generation with a small 135M model, reaching 310.19 tokens/sec, while its medium 7B model text generation speed was 18.57 tokens/sec.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio make this instance suitable for compute-bound workloads that do not require massive memory footprints. However, the lack of local NVMe storage and dedicated GPU accelerators represents a clear tradeoff, limiting its utility for large-scale database storage or heavy deep learning training. The instance is best suited for workloads such as software compilation, web serving, and moderate-scale LLM inference.
